success.description: With a gesture, you cast the spell.

sigmarsComet.description: Choose one target within the area of your winds. He is pushed one range increment away from you and suffers 2 fatigue.

conservative.requirements: 7 power. You must have a free hand, and cannot use that hand for anything else while this spell is recharging. Effect: A mighty wind bursts from your outstretched hand, blowing where you point. Choose a direction. Beginning from you and extending out to long range in that direction, the wind blows. Anyone to change range increment or towards you against the wind suffers 1 fatigue per manoeuvre he performs. The strong winds cause Ranged Attacks, Spells, Blessings, and other checks (as determined by the GM) to suffer a penalty equal to your depth in the Conservative stance.

success.description: You inhale deeply, then blow a mighty blast of wind at the target. The target is pushed back one range increment from you and knocked prone (he will have to spend a manoeuvre to stand up). If this blows him into a solid obstacle, such as a wall, he suffers wounds equal to your character rank. If this blows him off the edge of a cliff or similar, he falls.
As above, but the target suffers wounds whether or not he hits an obstacle.

sigmarsComet.description: A second target with To no higher than the first is also affected.
